content: अष्ठीला [अष्ठिस्तत्तुल्यकठिनाश्मानं राति; रा-क, रस्य लः दीर्घः <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A round swelling below the navel produced by wind. .²2 A kind of disease of urine. .²3 A globular or round body (in general). .²4 A round pebble or stone. ततो जज्ञे मांसपेशी लोहाष्ठीलेव संहता <ls>Mb. 1. 115. 12</ls>. .²5 Kernel. .²6 Seed corn.
